_comment: Rooms someone bought the shelving for, photographed after it went in.
The photographs came out of the design library through
'customer' is the account, kept here so it is clear which room this is.
'named' decides whether the post says it out loud. A reference is the
customer's name to give, not ours to take, so it stays false until they
have agreed; the post then says what kind of place it was instead, which
is what a buyer in the US is actually asking about.

installations.room: a store room off a teaching building
installations.situation: The room had to keep working while it was fitted out, on a floor where drilling was not an option.

installations.room: a windowless store room for departmental equipment
installations.situation: Eleven bays went up between terms, in a room with a slab floor and no time for a contractor.

installations.room: a sample store beside the laboratory floor
installations.situation: Samples have to be found again years later, so the tiers were set out before anything was ordered.

installations.room: the back of house behind the shop floor
installations.situation: The bays went in against a bare concrete wall, in the hours between closing and opening.

installations.room: a site store that moves with the job
installations.situation: It comes apart by hand and goes back together at the next site, which is why it was specified boltless.
